document_title: BIST Pay Endeksleri Temel Kurallari (Ekim 2019)
notes: Rulebook in force for the 2019Q4-2020 window. Art. 2.15 defines the four index periods; art. 2.16 requires periodic changes to be announced at least 10 calendar days before the index period starts; art. 6 defines the periodic add/remove bands (XU030 25/35, XU050 45/55, XU100 95/105) and the equal-in-equal-out rule and mandates 3 reserve shares; art. 7 defines NON-PERIODIC (donemsel olmayan) changes and their effective dates, all triggered by KAP disclosures.

document_title: BIST Pay Endeksleri Temel Kurallari (20 Aralik 2018)
notes: Period-correct rulebook for the 2018-2019 window, retained and reachable from announcement node 12305.

document_title: BIST Pay Endeksleri Temel Kurallari yeni pazar yapisi degisiklikleri ile guncellendi
notes: Announces the Ekim 2019 rulebook; cites circular 2019/68. Changes the XU030/XU050/XU100 selection universe to Yildiz Pazar, moves the XU100 band from 90-110 to 95-105, and sets the reserve count to 3.

document_title: BIST Pay Endeksleri Temel Kurallari BIST Likit Banka ve BIST Banka Disi Likit 10 uyumu icin guncellendi
